summary: Professional test suite with good separation of concerns across unit tests, workflow structure validation, and end-to-end act-based testing. Unit tests (PRLabelAssigner.Tests.ps1) comprehensively cover glob matching, priority ordering, group conflict resolution, and error handling. Workflow tests validate structure and actionlint compliance. However, coverage is incomplete without the actual workflow YAML file and supporting fixtures (PRLabelAssigner.psm1, labeler-rules.json, .actrc) shown in the codebase. Act tests are thorough but rely on assumptions about output format (LABELS_BEGIN/LABELS_END frame, ASSERTION_PASSED markers) that aren't validated as part of the workflow implementation itself. Edge case coverage is solid but could include very deep paths, special characters in filenames, and boundary conditions on rule properties. Test design is clean with good use of Pester features and helper functions, though Get-FramedLabel's ANSI-stripping logic is somewhat brittle. Overall, this would catch most regressions in core labeling logic, but end-to-end validation depends on proper workflow implementation of assertion mechanisms not shown here.
